name: A Grim Discovery
summary: Krueg Skullsplitter admits to having mentioned a bounty, and says the one who did the work deserves the best of the payoff. The horns are put in a crate for you to carry to Belgrom Rockmaul, found in the Valley of Honor in Orgrimmar, who will want your account. This follows the first A Grim Discovery.

sections.title: The Crate of Horns
sections.body: After the first A Grim Discovery, Krueg Skullsplitter is taken aback, then admits to mentioning a bounty. You did the work, so Krueg feels it only right that you take the best of the payoff. The horns are packed into a crate for you. The crate goes to Belgrom Rockmaul, found in the Valley of Honor, who wishes to hear what you saw and will make your hard work worth it.

sections.title: Belgrom's Interest
sections.body: Belgrom Rockmaul is struck by news of the Grimtotem and asks whether you truly met them out on a hunt in Feralas. Belgrom's peers will want the story, so you are asked to tell more while the coin is counted out. Belgrom ends with thanks for the information.

faq.q: Who gives this part of A Grim Discovery?
faq.answer: Krueg Skullsplitter, who has the horns put in a crate for you.

faq.q: Where does the crate of Grimtotem horns go?
aliases: where do i take the horns
faq.answer: To Belgrom Rockmaul, who waits in the Valley of Honor in Orgrimmar.
Krueg says you did the work, so the best of the payoff should rightly be yours.

faq.q: What does Belgrom want from you?
faq.answer: Krueg says Belgrom will be eager to hear what you saw, and will make your hard work worth it.
The first A Grim Discovery, in which you brought Krueg Grimtotem horns.
